title: Bicycle rental form
titleCn: 自行车租赁电话咨询填表

paragraphs.text: Part one. You will hear a telephone conversation between a man and a bicycle rental shop assistant.
Now look at the questions one to ten and answer all these questions.
Hello, Fast Cycle Rentals. This is Molly speaking. How can I assist you today?
Hi, Molly. I'm planning to explore the city over the weekend and thought renting a bike would be convenient. Could you tell me what options you have?

Absolutely. For casual city rides, we usually recommend the classic bicycle. It's a basic model, lightweight and easy to pedal on flat surfaces. Unless you're tackling hills or rough terrain, you won't need a mountain or hybrid bike.
No, I'll just be sticking to the main roads and paths. The classic one sounds fine.
Perfect.
You're in luck. We currently have a promotional offer. The rental fee is 52 pounds for the day, which is a reduction from our usual rate of 65.
That's reasonable. Do I need to leave a deposit or anything like that?
Yes, we do require a 40 deposit. It's fully refundable as long as the bike comes back undamaged.
So you'd be paying 92 pounds up front, but 40 of that comes back when you return it.
Got it. And what's included in that price?

Well, several things. First of all, we offer insurance that covers damage, so you're protected if the frame gets scratched or the gears get slightly bent. That won't apply to theft or major accidents though, only minor wear and tear.
That's good to know. Is any safety equipment included?
A helmet isn't part of the standard package, but you can rent one for 7 pounds if needed. It's not mandatory, but we recommend it for your own safety, especially if you're riding in traffic.
Right. I'll probably get one just to be safe.

As part of the rental, we'll give you a city map, which marks all the cycle-friendly streets and scenic routes. Also, the bike will come with lights at both the front and rear. Very important if you're planning to ride in the evening.
That's very helpful. Do you have anything for repairs in case something goes wrong?

Yes, we do offer an optional repair kit. It's a small pouch with basic tools, a mini pump, tire patches and a spanner, and we rent it out for just 3 pounds. It's particularly useful if you're riding outside the city center.
I'll take that too, just in case. Do you offer any kind of loyalty scheme or return customer benefit?
Actually, yes. If you rent from us again, we'll apply a reduction on your future hire. We really value returning clients.
That's a great incentive. Also, what time do you close tomorrow?
Normally, we shut the shop at 5:30, but tomorrow we'll be extending our hours and closing at 6:15 instead. We're expecting more visitors due to the local weekend market.
Great. I'll try to come by before that. And what's your address?
Sure. We're at 25 Clifton Street. That's spelled C-L-I-F-F-T-O-N. It's just off the main square right next to the post office. You can't miss it.
Perfect. Thanks so much for all the info, Molly.
No problem at all. We'll have everything ready when you arrive. See you soon.
